en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a terraced garden path on a steep riverbank. On the right, wooden and stone retaining walls support a slope covered with vegetation and lead up to a large wooden house with decorative latticework balconies. On the left, dense trees and shrubs overlook a wide river or lake stretching into the distance. At the bottom center, the caption reads "Haus Böhme."
